summary: Latency-sensitive smoke test on new Customer Portal, Marketing Campaigns, Marketing Toggle, and related backend endpoints. Backend root healthy. Two HIGH-priority blockers found that break the primary Customer Portal flow end-to-end. Auth-required flows (Marketing page, Manager Clients toggle in UI, Dashboard nav) were NOT tested via UI because Google OAuth login cannot be automated in this environment; backend endpoints for those were sanity-checked (auth guarded correctly).
passed: GET /api/ returns 200 with expected running status
POST /api/public/auth/passwordless correctly returns 400 'name_required' when phone not found and no name provided (existing-client path reachable)
PUT /api/clients/:id?accepts_marketing= correctly returns 401 when unauthenticated (auth guard present)
POST /api/marketing/campaigns correctly returns 422 for missing body fields (validation working, endpoint reachable)
CustomerPortal (/portal/:orgId) route loads and renders phone-login UI with react-phone-number-input, name field, and Ingresar button
Frontend form submission wires to backend and surfaces server errors as toasts (e.g. 'Por favor ingresa tu nombre' on 400)

failed.issue: Returns HTTP 500 when creating a NEW client. MongoDB insert_one mutates the new_client dict by injecting an ObjectId _id, then FastAPI's jsonable_encoder fails with: ValueError: [TypeError("'ObjectId' object is not iterable"), TypeError('vars() argument must have __dict__ attribute')]. Fix: pop or exclude '_id' from new_client before returning (e.g. new_client.pop('_id', None) after insert, or build a response dict without _id).
failed.evidence: curl POST /api/public/auth/passwordless with {phone, name, organization_id} -> 500 'Internal Server Error'. Backend traceback in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log at server.py lines ~633-654.

failed.issue: TypeError: publicAPI.getOrganization is not a function. CustomerPortal.js line ~33 calls publicAPI.getOrganization(orgId), but /app/frontend/src/api/index.js exports publicAPI with only getServices, getBarbers, getAvailability, createAppointment, getAppointment, cancelAppointment. Method must be added (e.g. getOrganization: (orgId) => axios.get(`${API}/public/${orgId}/organization`)) and/or a corresponding backend public endpoint must exist. Currently the portal shows a red 'Error al cargar información del negocio' toast on every load and the business-info card cannot render.
failed.evidence: Browser console: 'Error loading business info: TypeError: _api__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_2__.publicAPI.getOrganization is not a function' on GET /portal/test-org-123. Toast 'Error al cargar información del negocio' shown in top-right.

failed.issue: Two 401 responses fire on portal page load before user logs in. Likely a protected endpoint (e.g. /api/clients/history or similar) being called without a valid session token. Should be guarded to only call after successful passwordless login, or should use a truly public endpoint.
failed.evidence: Browser console shows two 'Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 401' on GET /portal/:orgId before any user interaction.

action_items: Backend: In POST /api/public/auth/passwordless (server.py ~lines 633-654), strip Mongo _id from new_client before returning. Simplest fix: add `new_client.pop('_id', None)` right after `await db.clients.insert_one(new_client)`. This unblocks new-client signup which is the entire point of the passwordless portal.

Frontend: Add `getOrganization: (orgId) => axios.get(`${API}/public/${orgId}/organization`)` (or equivalent) to publicAPI in /app/frontend/src/api/index.js, AND confirm/create the matching backend public endpoint returning business name, address, hours, WhatsApp link.
Frontend: Audit CustomerPortal.js useEffect chain to ensure no auth-protected endpoint is called before login (fix the two 401s on load).

After both fixes, re-test: (a) existing-client login round-trip, (b) new-client creation returns 200 with client object (no _id leaked), (c) business info card renders, (d) 'Book New Appointment' navigation, (e) then proceed to auth-gated Marketing Campaigns & Marketing Toggle flows.

success_rate.backend: 50% (2/4 relevant checks passed; new-client passwordless flow broken)
success_rate.frontend: 40% (portal renders and form wired, but business info + new-client creation broken end-to-end)

not_tested_due_to_blockers_or_auth: Marketing Campaigns page UI (requires manager/owner Google OAuth login)
ManagerClients marketing toggle UI (desktop & mobile) - requires login
org_id query preservation on navigation - requires login
Full customer portal dashboard (visits, appointment history, business info) - blocked by the two HIGH-priority bugs above
test_credentials: Present in /app/memory/test_credentials.md; Google OAuth cannot be automated in this env, so auth-gated UI flows are deferred.
